notes.title: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After 3 years of hard work, [b]The Excavation of Hob's Barrow[/b] is out now!

Our Victorian folk horror adventure has been published by the great [b]Wadjet Eye Games[/b], giving us the opportunity to include full voice acting (from an amazing cast) and achieve a level of polish that is a cut above our previous games. 

Please do check it out, we hope you enjoy it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182310/The_Excavation_of_Hobs_Barrow/

(The game had previously been known as INCANTAMENTUM earlier in development)

Thanks for your support,
Shaun, John and Laurie
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: INCANTAMENTUM - our next game now has a Steam page!
notes.notes:
Our next game is [b]INCANTAMENTUM.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182310/INCANTAMENTUM/

A mysterious letter brings noted barrow-digger Thomasina Bateman to the isolated and somewhat unwelcoming village of Bewlay, England. A subsequent series of strange events in this ancient and sodden landscape prove that this will be no ordinary dig for Miss Bateman.

The excavation of Hob's Barrow will uncover more than was bargained for...

[b]INCANTAMENTUM [/b]will be out later this year. Please do add it to your wishlists, it helps us a lot :) 

Thanks for your support,
Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games

notes.title: The Terrible Old Man - now available for free on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've just released The Terrible Old Man, our tiny H.P. Lovecraft point and click adaptation on Steam! 

[b]IT'S FREE! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147030/The_Terrible_Old_Man/

[i]Three men of loose virtue are enjoying a drink in a local tavern, when they overhear the story of a rich and feeble old man who lives in town. They soon plot to take his treasures...[/i]

This is a very short (and free) interactive adaptation of The Terrible Old Man, a short story by H.P. Lovecraft. The game was originally released back in 2015 - it was made in 30 days for the MAGS Game jam competition.

This Steam re-release features additional graphics and content, new music and Steam achievements!

[i]Features:[/i][list]
[*] An adaptation of the classic H.P. Lovecraft short story.
[*] Traditional point and click adventure interface.
[*] Unsettling hand drawn graphics and animation.
[*] Fully animated cut scenes.
[*] 640 x 360 widescreen resolution.
[*] HORROR!
[/list]

Please do check it out, hope you enjoy it :) 

Thanks for your support.

Shaun
[i]Cloak and Dagger Games[/i]

PS. There's also a super cheap DLC with a making of document including concept art, the soundtrack and the original jam version

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147040/The_Terrible_Old_Man__Collectors_Edition/

If you enjoyed the music please do consider picking up the soundtrack. It directly supports the musicians and hopefully will tempt them back to make music for our games again in the future :)
